text_block_list.text: I already have a training regimen prepared for Seiun Sky's next race, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: Are you okay? What are you staring at?
Are you okay? What are you staring at?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, for our next strategy, how about "Operation Cotton Candy"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on, take a look at those snow-white clouds floating up there in the blue sky…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All soft and fluffy like cotton candy. Don't they look delicious?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Imagine if they passed out cotton candy before a race. Then we could all celebrate like it was a festival… Yep, I'm losing it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now it's my head that's starting to go soft and fluffy…
Sky is so exhausted she can't even think straight. Looks like I'll need to rethink her schedule moving forward.
